task: Get ready to pick stuff up and put it in places, because you've just entered TextWorld! Here is how to play! First of all, you could, like, venture west. With that done, attempt to go to the north. And then, make absolutely sure that the hatch in the kitchenette is ajar. After pulling open the hatch, venture east. If you can get around to doing that, travel north. With that accomplished, pick up the keycard from the floor of the restroom. That's it!
